notes:
Top-line: mid-market SaaS vendor (product analytics/insights) evaluating Redwood for embeddings + semantic search. Initial hosted API POC for embeddings + search completed: good quality, cost estimates OK for developer flows. Now pushing to Dedicated for predictable nightly batch embed jobs and steady search QPS.

Key stakeholders: CTO (Maya Lin) - cares about throughput & cost, Head of Product (Carlos Mendez) - cares about relevance and rerank; Platform engineer (Anya Kov) owner of infra and vector DB. AE is Jamie Ortega, SE is Nina Patel, CSM prospect is Omar Reyes.

POC summary:
- 2/18 call: intro + architecture review (ff link above).
- 2/24: hosted API POC ingest 150k docs (nightly job simulated with 6 parallel workers). Completed, average embedding latency 48ms/token-equivalent, indexing to Pinecone produced 95th pctile query latency 180ms under light load.
- 3/02: demo of Dedicated throughput (ff perf-demo). We ran synthetic QPS 120 qps across 3 model variants; Redwood fallback worked as expected when capacity throttled.

What they like: transparent token-level cost breakdown, rollout/canary features, automatic KV caching ideas. Quote from Carlos: "Quality is great — but we need predictable nightly cost for batch runs."

Technical asks / acceptance criteria:
- Sustained search QPS 100-150 with 95th pctile latency <300ms (including vector DB network time).
- Nightly batch embed job: 200k docs finished within 6 hours at < $X per 1k embeddings (pricing sensitivity).
- Support for pgvector + managed vector DB integrations (they currently use Postgres + pgvector in prod, evaluating Pinecone/Weaviate).
- SSO/SAML + audit logs + ability to store keys in customer's KMS.

Pricing convo: SE presented committed capacity pricing sheet on 3/2; price gap noted vs using OpenAI + Pinecone for embeddings at scale. Discussion focuses on unit economics of batching, caching, and quantized model variants. Prospect asked for a 12-month reserved capacity proposal that includes burst allowance.

Procurement/legal: legal needs DPA + SOC2 report before enabled Dedicated in VPC. Security team requested a 3rd-party penetration test summary.

Next steps (short bullets):
- Provide committed capacity quote by 2026-03-12 (ACTION: Jamie).
- Run combined latency benchmark with their pgvector staging cluster (ACTION: Nina + Anya) — target window 2026-03-15 to 2026-03-17.
- Provide SOC2 and KMS integration docs + draft DPA (LINK: drive security doc).
- Follow-up call to review quote and benchmark results (schedule wk of 2026-03-22).
